name: MobileViTAttention

patch_size.description: patch size (must divide H and W)

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, patch_size, kernel_size=3):
    import math
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    in_channel = x.shape[1]
    dim = in_channel
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if b == 0 or c == 0 or h == 0 or w == 0:
        return x
    conv1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size//2).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv2 = nn.Conv2d(c, dim, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv3 = nn.Conv2d(dim, c, 1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    conv4 = nn.Conv2d(2*c, c, kernel_size, padding=kernel_size//2).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    to_qkv = nn.Linear(dim, dim*3, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    to_out = nn.Linear(dim, dim).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    y = conv2(conv1(x))
    ph, pw = patch_size, patch_size
    nh, nw = h // ph, w // pw
    y = y.reshape(b, dim, nh, ph, nw, pw).permute(0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1).reshape(b, ph*pw, nh*nw, dim)
    qkv = to_qkv(y).reshape(b, ph*pw, nh*nw, 3, -1).permute(3, 0, 1, 2, 4)
    q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
    attn = F.softmax(torch.matmul(q.float(), k.float().transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(dim), dim=-1)
    y = torch.matmul(attn, v.float()).to(dtype=x.dtype).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, ph*pw, nh*nw, dim)
    y = to_out(y)
    y = y.reshape(b, ph, pw, nh, nw, dim).permute(0, 5, 3, 1, 4, 2).reshape(b, dim, h, w)
    y = conv3(y)
    y = torch.cat([x, y], 1)
    y = conv4(y)
    return y
